text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Faced with formidable rivals, Ines Fujin 
suffered defeat at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet her family and friends praised her 
great effort, showering her with cheers. 
Everyone had been completely captivated by 
her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin running is by no means selfish. 
It is the embodiment of everyone's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was okay to have fun, and it was okay 
to run as much as she wanted. Realizing 
this, warm tears glistened on Ines Fujin's 
cheeks.
